paragraphs.zh: mit der Maßgabe, daß -L-R1 nicht für gegebenenfalls substituiertes CH2-O-Phenyl stehen soll, wenn R2 und R3 jeweils Chlor  und R4 und R5 jeweils Wasserstoff bedeuten.
paragraphs.en: with the proviso that -L-R1 is not to stand for optionally substituted CH2-O-phenyl when R2 and R3 are each chlorine and R4 and R5 are each hydrogen.
paragraphs.notes: This WO publication prints no [00NN] paragraph markers anywhere, so marker is null. The page opens mid-sentence: this is the tail of a proviso that begins on the previous page. In the print, the digits after R and the 2 in CH2 are superscript and subscript respectively; transcribed here on the line, since the field is plain text. The double space between 'Chlor' and 'und' is as printed and has been kept.

paragraphs.zh: Zahlreiche erfindungsgemäße Verbindungen der Formel (I) können in Abhängigkeit von äußeren Bedingungen, wie Lösungsmittel und pH-Wert, in unterschiedlichen tautomeren Strukturen auftreten.
paragraphs.en: Numerous compounds of the formula (I) according to the invention can occur in different tautomeric structures depending on external conditions such as solvent and pH.

paragraphs.zh: Für den Fall, daß R6  für Hydroxy steht, sind folgende tautomeren Strukturen möglich:
paragraphs.en: In the case where R6 stands for hydroxy, the following tautomeric structures are possible:
paragraphs.notes: The 6 after R is printed as a superscript. There is a wide gap in the print between 'R6' and 'für', kept here as a double space. This sentence is the caption for the drawing below it.

paragraphs.zh: Je nach Art der Substituenten enthalten die Verbindungen der allgemeinen Formel (I) ein acides Proton, das durch Umsetzung mit einer Base entfernt werden kann. Als Basen eignen sich beispielsweise Alkalimetalle, wie Lithium, Natrium und Kalium, Erdalkalimetalle, wie Calcium und Magnesium, Ammoniak und organische Amine. Solche Salze sind ebenfalls Gegenstand der Erfindung.
paragraphs.en: Depending on the nature of the substituents, the compounds of the general formula (I) contain an acidic proton which can be removed by reaction with a base. Suitable bases are, for example, alkali metals such as lithium, sodium and potassium, alkaline earth metals such as calcium and magnesium, ammonia and organic amines. Such salts are likewise a subject of the invention.
paragraphs.notes: Translated literally. The German as printed calls the alkali and alkaline earth METALS themselves bases ('Als Basen eignen sich beispielsweise Alkalimetalle'); loosely, their hydroxides or other basic derivatives are meant, but the printed wording has not been corrected.

drawings.notes: Four generic Markush structures laid out 2x2 and joined by six two-headed equilibrium arrow pairs (top horizontal, bottom horizontal, left vertical, right vertical, and two crossed diagonals), so every structure is shown in equilibrium with every other. This is NOT a synthetic route and not prior art: the preceding paragraph introduces it as the tautomeric forms of the invention's own compounds of formula (I) for the case where R6 is hydroxy. No reagents or conditions are written on any arrow. No SMILES is given for any structure because the ring is a Markush with variable ring members Y and Z, a variable (CH2)v unit and a floating (R7)w, and because L, R1 to R5 are all undefined on this page; every atom is not determined by the drawing. Aryl positions are read off the drawing: going round the benzene from the ipso carbon in the direction of R2, the order drawn is R2, L-R1, R3, R4, R5.

discrepancies.what: The prose fixes R6 as hydroxy for this drawing, but no R6 label appears anywhere in the four drawn tautomers; the hydroxy is drawn out as an explicit OH (or as the corresponding C=O in the keto forms) instead.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Four structures labelled only with L, R1, R2, R3, R4, R5, (R7)w, Y, Z, v, w and explicit O / OH atoms. No R6 anywhere.
discrepancies.text_says: 'Für den Fall, daß R6 für Hydroxy steht, sind folgende tautomeren Strukturen möglich:'

discrepancies.what: The four structures drawn are said in the caption to be the tautomers 'possible' for R6 = hydroxy, but the top-left structure as drawn carries no hydroxy group at all: it is the fully keto triketone form. Recording the discrepancy rather than deciding which reading is intended.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Top-left structure has three C=O groups (two ring, one exocyclic aroyl) and a CH at ring C2; no OH.
discrepancies.text_says: The set is introduced as the tautomeric structures for the case that R6 stands for hydroxy.
